display_message.name: Show a message on the display
display_message.description: Shows text on the soundbar's front display, on or in standby, without waking it. The display shows capital letters without accents: the text is converted ("Fridge open" shows as FRIDGE OPEN). The bar's own messages (volume, HELLO…) come first; yours waits and continues.

message.name: Message
message.description: Up to 31 characters after conversion: letters, digits, space and - . : ! ? '.

id.name: Id
id.description: Name of the message (a-z, 0-9, _ and -). A new message with the same id replaces it, so "fridge closed" can replace "fridge open". Messages with different ids take turns, each with its own repeat, duration or until cancelled.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Number of passes (1-99). Default: one pass. Choose repeat, duration or forever, not several.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Repeat the message for this long (up to 24 h); the last pass is shown to its end.

forever.name: Until cancelled
forever.description: Repeat until the message is cancelled or replaced by one with the same id.

display_cancel.name: Cancel a display message
display_cancel.description: Stops the message with this id, or every message when no id is given.

id.name: Id
id.description: Id of the message to stop. Empty: every message.

timer_start.name: Start a timer
timer_start.description: Starts a timer on the soundbar. When the time is up, TIME'S UP and the name scroll on its display, on or in standby, until a key on the JBL remote is pressed (10 minutes at most). Names use letters, digits, space and - . ' only, and two timers cannot share a name.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional, e.g. Pizza. Shown as PIZZA. Without a name the alarm reads TIME'S UP - PRESS ANY KEY; only one timer without a name at a time.

show_time_left.name: Show the time left
show_time_left.description: On the bar: second by second when it is the only timer, once a minute (PIZZA 4'34) when several run.

sound.name: Sound at the end
sound.description: off; unless_tv: not while the bar plays TV, optical or HDMI, so a film is never cut; always. The bar plays a chime through its Chromecast, then returns to its volume, source or standby.

sound_volume.name: Sound volume at least
sound_volume.description: 1 to 30 (default 10). The bar is unmuted and turned up to this volume if lower, never down.

ring_for.name: Ring for
ring_for.description: How long the chime repeats (3 s to 5 min, default 30 s). A key on the JBL remote stops it.

timer_cancel.name: Stop a timer
timer_cancel.description: Stops a timer, running or ringing: by name, by id, or all of them.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name given at start (empty: the timer without a name).

id.name: Id
id.description: The id from the Timers sensor, e.g. t3.

timer_extend.name: Add time to a timer
timer_extend.description: Adds time to a running timer (1 minute by default): by name or id, otherwise the next one to end. A ringing timer cannot be extended.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name given at start (empty: the timer without a name).

id.name: Id
id.description: The id from the Timers sensor, e.g. t3.
